verdict.rationale: Paddle is a billing and merchant-of-record SaaS that handles customer and account data, so a buyer could reasonably ask whether it offers an AI-training opt-out. The axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a policy, setting, or contractual control that keeps user data out of AI model training. Docs-42 mentions 'stale training data' only about agents' knowledge, and the community privacy comments concern access to customer emails, not AI training, so neither is relevant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
